import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 202;
    static final int INF = 0x3f3f3f3f;
    
    static int[][] flow = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[][] capacity = new int[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] parent = new int[MAXN];
    static int[] queue_bfs = new int[MAXN * MAXN];
    static int[] dist = new int[MAXN];
    
    static int BFS_edmonds(int totalNodes, int src, int dst) {
        int head, tail, node, u, v;
        while (true) {
            Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
            dist[src] = INF;
            head = tail = 0;
            queue_bfs[tail++] = src;
            while (head < tail && parent[dst] < 0) {
                node = queue_bfs[head++];
                for (u = 0; u < totalNodes; ++u) {
                    if (parent[u] < 0 && (v = capacity[node][u] - flow[node][u]) > 0) {
                        parent[queue_bfs[tail++] = u] = node;
                        dist[u] = Math.min(dist[node], v);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (parent[dst] < 0) break;
            for (u = dst; u != src; u = parent[u]) {
                flow[parent[u]][u] += dist[dst];
                flow[u][parent[u]] -= dist[dst];
            }
        }
        int total = 0;
        for (u = 0; u < totalNodes; ++u) total += flow[src][u];
        return total;
    }
    
    static char[][] initial = new char[11][];
    static char[][] target = new char[11][];
    static int Zr, Zc;
    static int[][] offsets = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};
    static int[][] dists = new int[101][101];
    static int N, T;
    static List<Integer> rowsB = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Integer> colsB = new ArrayList<>();
    
    static void bfs_run(int r, int c, int[] outDists, boolean withCheck) {
        Queue<int[]> Q = new LinkedList<>();
        outDists[r * N + c] = 0;
        Q.offer(new int[]{r, c});
        while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = Q.poll();
            int x = cell[0];
            int y = cell[1];
            int idx = x * N + y;
            int curDist = outDists[idx];
            if (withCheck && (dists[Zr * N + Zc][idx] <= curDist || T <= curDist)) {
                if (dists[Zr * N + Zc][idx] < curDist || T < curDist) {
                    outDists[idx] = INF + 1;
                }
                continue;
            }
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {
                int nx = x + offsets[k][0];
                int ny = y + offsets[k][1];
                if (nx < 0 || ny < 0 || nx == N || ny == N) continue;
                if (target[nx][ny] < '0' || target[nx][ny] > '9') continue;
                int nidx = nx * N + ny;
                if (outDists[nidx] != INF) continue;
                outDists[nidx] = curDist + 1;
                Q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }
    
    static void setup() {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (target[i][j] >= '1' && target[i][j] <= '9') {
                    rowsB.add(i);
                    colsB.add(j);
                    capacity[(i * N + j) + 2 + N * N][1] = target[i][j] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        int zIdx = Zr * N + Zc;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (initial[i][j] >= '1' && initial[i][j] <= '9') {
                    int idx = i * N + j;
                    capacity[0][idx + 2] = initial[i][j] - '0';
                    for (int k = 0; k < rowsB.size(); ++k) {
                        int ri = rowsB.get(k);
                        int ci = colsB.get(k);
                        int qi = ri * N + ci;
                        if (dists[idx][qi] < INF) {
                            capacity[idx + 2][qi + 2 + N * N] = INF;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        for (int i = 0; i < 11; ++i) {
            initial[i] = new char[11];
            target[i] = new char[11];
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                initial[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                target[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                Arrays.fill(dists[i * N + j], 0, N * N, INF);
                if (initial[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    Zr = i;
                    Zc = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        bfs_run(Zr, Zc, dists[Zr * N + Zc], false);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
                if (initial[i][j] >= '1' && initial[i][j] <= '9') {
                    bfs_run(i, j, dists[i * N + j], true);
                }
            }
        }
        
        setup();
        System.out.println(BFS_edmonds(2 + N * N + N * N, 0, 1));
    }
}
